what: Berkshire Hathaway, Warren Buffett's company, fully owns dozens of businesses: insurance (GEICO and reinsurance), the BNSF railroad, utilities and energy, and industrial and consumer brands. It also holds a large stock portfolio (Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola and others).
customers: GEICO policyholders, shippers using BNSF, utility customers, and the customers of its many brands (Dairy Queen, Duracell, See's Candies and more).
money: auto insurance and reinsurance premiums, plus income from investing the float
dozens of industrial and consumer companies
dividends and interest on a huge cash pile
moat: An exceptionally strong balance sheet with hundreds of billions in cash, cheap insurance float, and diversification across many businesses.
risks: Large insurance losses from natural disasters
